desc: Implement small-N brute-force checker and direct quadratic DP to validate recurrence and boundary conditions.
Implement compressed bad-event inclusion-exclusion DP with quadratic recurrence and pass public samples.
Design near-linear algorithm for recurrence: CDQ/NTT or alternative, handle monotone events and large slack.
Implement optimized solver and integrate into main modulo 998244353.
Validate optimized solver against quadratic/DP on random small cases and edge cases; test performance for N=2e5.
